about.body: I'm a junior software developer from Mollet del Vallès, near Barcelona. After a Flutter internship of about eight months at Accenture, I'm now taking an official VET specialisation course in cloud (AWS and OpenNebula) at the Institut Tecnològic de Barcelona. I also work part-time for my family's renovation company, where I build and run the website and the Google Ads campaigns; the campaigns have helped increase its turnover. From April 2027, when the course ends, I'll be available full-time for software development (Flutter, web) or cloud infrastructure roles, in Barcelona or remotely.

acc.pill: Internship · part of the DAM diploma
acc.meta: Barcelona (Sant Gervasi office) · 18 Sep 2025 – 14 May 2026 (≈8 months, ≈435 hours) · internship through Tecnilógica Ecosistemas, S.A.U. (Accenture group)
acc.lead: A Flutter app in production for a leading Spanish bank: consumer financing at the point of sale (in-store credit), used by large retail chains and thousands of users.
acc.team: Scrum with two-week sprints and daily stand-ups · GitLab merge requests, code review and continuous integration · Jira and Confluence · with designers, QA and backend developers
acc.sprintsAria: What I worked on in each period of the internship

sprints.d: Onboarding: Flutter SDK, Android Studio, VS Code, GitLab and Jira; learnt the GetX architecture (controllers, routes, bindings); first supervised UI fixes.
New visual components following the design guidelines; images, SVG icons (flutter_svg) and Lottie animations; Android, iOS and web set-up; usability tests on devices.
Responsive UI for phone and tablet (MediaQuery, LayoutBuilder); fixed keyboard, overflow, sticky-footer, landscape and SafeArea bugs; checked the HTTPS network set-up.
REST API integration with JSON → Dart model mapping; read the app's logical data design and helped implement it; fixed scroll, sticky-footer and navigation-drawer bugs; technical documentation.
Refactored UI components; optimised navigation flows and the UX of the financing processes; fewer widget rebuilds (const constructors); code reviews and regression testing.
New features and screens for the financing flows from the design team's specs; device checks with QA; resolved incidents in Jira.
Android APK / AAB distribution builds with Firebase App Distribution; final usability checks; closing documentation.

bullets: Dart with GetX state management; REST API integration (authentication, error handling)
Fixed complex UX bugs in production on Android and iOS: landscape layouts, sticky footers, overflows, drawer, keyboard, scrolling
Responsive refactor for mobile and tablet
Agile/Scrum sprints in a team, with Jira, GitLab and code reviews
